name: Diana Arsenii
title: Frontend Engineer
summary: Frontend Engineer with 7+ years of experience building and optimizing web, cross-platform, and native applications across consumer streaming, gaming, and FinTech. Experienced in React, TypeScript, React Native, and native iOS development.
about: I’m a frontend engineer with deep hands-on experience in product delivery, performance optimization, and cross-platform product development. I care about building reliable interfaces that feel effortless for users and practical for teams to maintain.

My work spans consumer streaming, gaming, and FinTech products, with a strong focus on frontend architecture, platform constraints, and end-to-end feature ownership. I’ve partnered with product, design, backend, and platform teams to move from ambiguous requirements to confident release decisions.

I’m especially interested in systems that need both UX quality and engineering discipline: performance-sensitive UI, reusable component architecture, accessibility, and cross-platform consistency. My approach is grounded in ownership, clear trade-offs, and measurable outcomes.
